name: LiDAR Ruler (for phone)
description: Point your phone at the scene, tap up to three objects, and read their distances live in the camera view. Markers stay anchored and the labels update as you move. Uses the phone's depth sensor (LiDAR / ARCore) through WebXR augmented reality where available; elsewhere — including iPhone Safari — it falls back to a camera + tilt-sensor estimate. Everything runs locally in the browser.
note: Sensor-accurate AR measuring needs a WebXR browser (Chrome on Android). iPhone Safari doesn't expose LiDAR to web pages, so there the app triangulates distances from the phone's tilt and height instead — a good estimate, clearly labelled as one.
